title: AWARE 2.0 RLM configuration
description: Declarative config for invoking the RLM (Recursive Language Model) primitive inside AWARE. Read by src/config/rlm.cjs at boot (planned). Validated by the A1.1 bring-up smoke test. Defaults live in config/rlm.yaml; prose lives in docs/rlm.md. BLOCK-13 fix (A1.1.2, 2026-06-28 ~13:40 UTC): 6 field groups added (rlm.context, rlm.forwardedOptions, rlm.decompositionScope, rlm.audit.preferencePair, top-level errors, rlm.sandbox.envMode); additionalProperties:false added at all object levels so unknown fields are rejected at the schema layer (defense-in-depth, complements the C1 runtime hook that catches the same issues at boot).

$schema.description: Optional reference to the schema file. Not validated.

rlm.description: Top-level RLM namespace. All 13 fields are required by policy: an RLM adapter that silently defaults a field has no way to know whether the operator ever saw the value.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the adapter short-circuits and never invokes rlm(). Audit logs the disablement.

budgetUsd.description: Per-call USD cap. null = no cap (cost recorded but never enforced). Number = opt in to enforcement. Per Alvin directive 2026-06-27: no product-level budget limit; v1 ships with null.

tree.description: Default tree shape for recursive decomposition. Defaults (maxDepth=2, branching=3, K=4) yield 9 leaves at default config, sub_calls = 2 * N_non_leaf + N_leaves = 17 per A1.1.1 formula.

maxDepth.description: Max recursion depth. Capped at 5 to prevent absurd costs even without budget enforcement.

K.description: Top-level K (number of children the root spawns).

preferParallel.description: OOS for v1; schema still types it so a future migration does not have to widen the schema.

context.description: Context shape accepted by rlm() (BLOCK-1 resolution). fieldName='type' (NOT 'kind' from ARCHITECTURE §5). allowedTypes is the v1 enum per SPEC §3.2; sqlite deferred to v1.1 (BLOCK-11).

allowedTypes.description: v1 enum. sqlite/buffer/repo deferred to v1.1 per ARCHITECTURE §10. Hard-coded to exactly 3 items so adding a 4th context type requires a schema change (visible to operators).

fieldName.description: Field name discriminator. SPEC §3.2 uses 'type'; ARCHITECTURE §5 used 'kind' (the stale doc).

defaultKind.description: When no kind is specified. Must be in allowedTypes.

maxBytes.description: Hard cap on context.bytes; raises RlmContextTooLargeError (BLOCK-6) when exceeded. Default 10 MiB.

forwardedOptions.description: Options rlm() forwards to leaves (BLOCK-3 + BLOCK-8 resolution). matches HeavySkill's actual verify.js + prm.js signatures.

verification.description: Verification forwarded to leaves. executionMethod=exec is a code-execution vector and is documented as a security consideration in docs/rlm.md.

enabled.description: When true, leaves run their own verify.js (with the configured method).

allowedMethods.description: Methods leaves may use. 'exec' = code execution; 'llm-judge' = LLM-based verification (safer).

defaultMethod.description: Default method when caller doesn't specify. llm-judge is the safer default.

prm.description: Process Reward Model forwarded to leaves for PRM-weighted aggregation (BLOCK-5).

enabled.description: When true, PRM scores are computed and used in aggregation.

tools.description: REPL tool whitelist. AST filter enforces it on leaf-emitted code.

allowed.description: Whitelisted REPL tools. 7-tool surface per SPEC §11; vec_search and len are load-bearing for the AWARE retrieval context.

workspaceDir.description: Absolute path to the REPL workspace root. All REPL path operations are confined to this directory (F-003 / F-004). Deployment must set this to a real path; default /var/aware/rlm/workspace is a placeholder.

decompositionFormat.description: Decomposition prompt format. plain-text only for v1 (BLOCK-2 resolution). json dropped from the enum because no valid use case exists in v1; the prior version allowed json to encourage forward migration, but that rationale is moot since the 7-tool whitelist already constrains the migration surface.

decompositionScope.description: Decomposition scope. v1 ships with every-non-leaf only (matches ~/src/rlm/src/rlm/tree.js:63). root-only is REJECTED at the schema layer because the implementation does not support it and a reverted YAML would silently produce wrong sub_calls accounting. The previous schema allowed both values for back-compat; BLOCK-13 + A1.1.1 + this revision close the back-compat door to prevent future drift.

sandbox.description: REPL sandbox policy. enforcement=required refuses any rlm() call without an active sandbox.

enforcement.description: Sandbox enforcement level. v1 requires 'required'; advisory and disabled are REJECTED at the schema layer (defense-in-depth: prior version allowed 'advisory' and 'disabled' which silently weakened security). Per F-007/F-011/F-015.

privilegeDrop.description: Whether the REPL subprocess drops setuid/setgid before exec. v1 requires 'required' (F-015).

opFilter.description: Leaf-emitted code op filter. ast-whitelist uses Python ast + JS acorn. 'none' is permitted for development but should be locked to ast-whitelist in production.

seccomp.description: Whether the library's seccomp profile (blocks socket/connect/accept/recv/send) is active.

landlock.description: Landlock availability. linux-only is the v1 default; macOS has no landlock and is supported-with-caveats.

envMode.description: REPL env handling. 'cleared' = env -i (FLAG-18 resolution; SPEC §11 wins over ARCHITECTURE §5's 'PATH + LANG only'). 'minimal' = a curated allow-list (future option; not in v1 docs).

wallClockSeconds.description: Per round-trip wall-clock cap, in seconds.

audit.description: Audit-log canonical field names. The const fields are F-008 protected: no override.

component.description: Audit component name. F-008 — no override.

kindNode.description: Per-tree-node audit kind discriminator. F-008 — no override.

costRecorded.description: When cost is recorded in the audit log. always records regardless of budget enforcement; on-budget records only when enforcement is on.

redactFields.description: Audit-log fields stripped before persistence. Unknown fields fail validation so the redaction surface stays explicit. F-016 (Sentinel audit pending before C1 lands).

preferencePair.description: Preference pair record shape (BLOCK-9 + BLOCK-10 resolution). Defers to HeavySkill's exact shape; rlm-specific extension goes under 'tree' sub-field. ONE pair per rlm() call (BLOCK-10).

discriminatorField.description: Field used to discriminate root vs leaf pairs in the shared JSONL stream.

rootComponentValue.description: Value of component for root-level pairs.

leafComponentValue.description: Value of component for leaf-level pairs (preserves HeavySkill's existing shape).

schema.description: Schema authority. heavy-skill = defer to ~/src/heavy-think/src/preference-pair.js exact shape.

perCallOnly.description: ONE pair per rlm() call (BLOCK-10). The per-internal-node claim in ARCHITECTURE §9 is dropped. const=true so the override is rejected at the schema layer.

treeSubfield.description: Field name for the rlm-specific extension to HeavySkill's pair record. Holds the tree object.

fewShotExamples.description: In-context few-shot examples. Hard-coded to 0 for v1; deferred to v2. min=max=0 forces exact 0.

killSwitch.description: When true, the adapter refuses to invoke rlm() and audit-logs the refusal. Lazy getter.

errors.description: Error-class thresholds. RlmContextTooLargeError is raised when context.bytes exceeds this threshold (BLOCK-6).

contextTooLargeThresholdBytes.description: RlmContextTooLargeError threshold. Default 10 MiB. Min 1 KiB; max 1 GiB.
